about: Rebecca Abrams Sarelson attended law school and graduated from University of Florida Levin College of Law in 2002. Rebecca Abrams Sarelson began practicing law in 2003.
Rebecca Abrams Sarelson is an attorney at Saul Ewing LLP, helping people with Tax issues. Saul Ewing LLP has an office in Miami, Florida, serving the local community.

Rebecca Abrams Sarelson was selected to Rising Stars for 2010 - 2011. Rising Stars is an exclusive list of top-rated attorneys in specific practice areas who were chosen after thorough evaluation of numerous criteria.

The Super Lawyers patented selection process is peer influenced and research driven, selecting the top 5% of attorneys to the Super Lawyers lists each year. We know lawyers and make it easy to connect with them.
